dog.description_text: Meet Diana — New Arrival! Diana just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about her time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/GRP_NYC_Foster/IQDv1RjoimQkR69sgrt4YCNsAVBndwVF5Itm4PFlXkeiymw?e=C41grI Diana is sweet and cuddly. She is affectionate and likes to to be pet. Her foster says " now she sleeps on the couch, in her cat bed, and next to me cuddling in bed. She freely explores the entire house now and has become much more comfortable and curious. She’s still a little scared of loud noises, but she’s definitely becoming more confident and explorative. She has a small appetite, but drinks plenty of water and enjoys small snacks throughout the day. She is incredibly sweet and cuddly and loves being close to me. She’s happiest when she’s curled up next to me, whether we’re relaxing in bed or hanging out around the house." Diana is a 5 year old female tabby. She is spayed, microchipped, vaccinated, and has had preventative treatments to ensure she is ready for her next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
